description: Source code for Adobe's CFF Interpreter (body) in the FreeType project, implementing the interpretation of Type 2 charstrings for font rendering.

methods.name: cf2_hintmask_init
methods.description: Initializes a CF2_HintMask structure, setting error pointer.

methods.name: cf2_hintmask_isValid
methods.description: Checks if the hint mask is valid.

methods.name: cf2_hintmask_isNew
methods.description: Checks if the hint mask is new.

methods.name: cf2_hintmask_setNew
methods.description: Sets the isNew flag of the hint mask.

methods.name: cf2_hintmask_getMaskPtr
methods.description: Returns pointer to the hint mask byte array.

methods.name: cf2_hintmask_setCounts
methods.description: Sets the bit and byte counts for the hint mask, validating maximum hints.

methods.name: cf2_hintmask_read
methods.description: Reads hint mask bytes from the charstring buffer and advances pointer.

methods.name: cf2_hintmask_setAll
methods.description: Sets all bits in the hint mask to 1, clearing unused bits.

methods.name: cf2_doStems
methods.description: Processes stem hints from operand stack and updates hint arrays.

methods.name: cf2_doFlex
methods.description: Processes flex operators for font outline drawing.

methods.name: cf2_interpT2CharString
methods.description: Main interpreter for Type 2 charstrings, executing font drawing commands.
